title: Glorious
review: I thought this was trying way too hard as a comedy. The jokes were a too obvious and overwrought, and the comedic timing was terrible. I wouldn't be surprised if they only had J. K. Simmons for a day or two in the recording studio after filming, so he couldn't time his lines naturally against the lead. It starts off focussing on comedy over horror, and therefore sets a bad first impression. The pivot towards horror half way through had be feeling relieved. They use a vast amount of blood, but it's not deployed in a fun or funny way. They're trying to do the dark modern supernatural themes of Neil Gaiman, and the quip comedy of Joss Whedon. At least neither of those men were involved, but we're still left with a Temu quality attempt at copying their work. I think it'll prove to be more memorable than your average low-budget streaming original, but I wouldn't recommend it.
